description: I'm looking to build a team of enthusiastic, creative, and motivated individuals who are willing to learn, share ideas, and work together to create something amazing. I believe a great team is built on collaboration, good communication, diverse perspectives, and a shared passion for achieving a common goal.
summary:
From June to September, southwest monsoon clouds blind optical satellites like Sentinel-2 over Karnataka. For four months, we lose clear-sky views just as reservoirs hit flood stage and Western Ghats slopes fail. The NASA-ISRO NISAR mission cuts through this cloud deck using 24 cm L-band radar every 12 days, but raw decibel backscatter and polarimetric matrices mean very little to a local dam engineer or forest guard.

We built Namma SARs, meaning Our SAR in Kannada, to make NISAR imagery directly usable across all 31 districts of Karnataka in both English and Kannada. Built with React and Three.js, our 3D console maps multi-band radar composites across two modes: Water and Deforestation. Water Mode uses co-polarized HH returns to distinguish dark, mirror-like open water from flooded vegetation and exposed mudflats at reservoirs like KRS, Tungabhadra, and Almatti. Deforestation Mode tracks drops in cross-polarized HV canopy scattering to catch timber loss in Kodagu and Malnad. Paired with a 12-day pass timeline, geolocation threat ranging, and 3 dB alert triggers, it turns orbital radar physics into daily field decisions.
